titleEn: Maximum Number of Groups Getting Fresh Donuts
title: 得到新鲜甜甜圈的最多组数
summary: 每批 batchSize 个甜甜圈新鲜出炉，各组依次领取 group 大小的甜甜圈；调整组顺序，最大化拿到批次首个甜甜圈的组数。
insight: 只关心组大小模 batchSize。余数零组必开心；其余余数计数用五位编码成状态，记忆化搜索当前未用余数，若当前批次余量为零则下一个组开心。
pitfalls: 状态还需包含当前已用余数
每类计数最多三十可用五位编码

solutions.title: 余数计数状态 DP
solutions.idea: 枚举余数组顺序并缓存等价计数状态。
steps: 统计 counts[remainder]，answer 初始 counts[0]
把 counts[1..] 每类编码为 long 的五位字段
dfs(state,current)：若 state=0 返回零；枚举 count>0 的 remainder，得分 current==0?1:0 加递归，取最大

code.java: class Solution { int batchSize;Map<Long,Integer> memo=new HashMap<>();private int dfs(long state,int current){if(state==0)return 0;long key=state*batchSize+current;if(memo.containsKey(key))return memo.get(key);int best=0;for(int remainder=1;remainder<batchSize;remainder++){int shift=(remainder-1)*5;if(((state>>shift)&31)==0)continue;best=Math.max(best,(current==0?1:0)+dfs(state-(1L<<shift),(current+remainder)%batchSize));}memo.put(key,best);return best;}public int maxHappyGroups(int batchSize,int[] groups){this.batchSize=batchSize;int[] count=new int[batchSize];for(int group:groups)count[group%batchSize]++;long state=0;for(int remainder=1;remainder<batchSize;remainder++)state|=(long)count[remainder]<<((remainder-1)*5);return count[0]+dfs(state,0);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private var batchSize=0;private val memo=mutableMapOf<Long,Int>();private fun dfs(state:Long,current:Int):Int{if(state==0L)return 0;val key=state*batchSize+current;memo[key]?.let{return it};var best=0;for(remainder in 1 until batchSize){val shift=(remainder-1)*5;if(state shr shift and 31L==0L)continue;best=maxOf(best,(if(current==0)1 else 0)+dfs(state-(1L shl shift),(current+remainder)%batchSize))};memo[key]=best;return best};fun maxHappyGroups(batchSize:Int,groups:IntArray):Int{this.batchSize=batchSize;memo.clear();val count=IntArray(batchSize);for(group in groups)count[group%batchSize]++;var state=0L;for(remainder in 1 until batchSize)state=state or (count[remainder].toLong() shl ((remainder-1)*5));return count[0]+dfs(state,0)} }
code.cpp: class Solution { int batchSize;unordered_map<long long,int> memo;int dfs(long long state,int current){if(!state)return 0;long long key=state*batchSize+current;if(memo.count(key))return memo[key];int best=0;for(int remainder=1;remainder<batchSize;++remainder){int shift=(remainder-1)*5;if(!((state>>shift)&31))continue;best=max(best,(!current)+dfs(state-(1LL<<shift),(current+remainder)%batchSize));}return memo[key]=best;}public:int maxHappyGroups(int inputBatchSize,vector<int>& groups){batchSize=inputBatchSize;memo.clear();vector<int> count(batchSize);for(int group:groups)++count[group%batchSize];long long state=0;for(int remainder=1;remainder<batchSize;++remainder)state|=1LL*count[remainder]<<((remainder-1)*5);return count[0]+dfs(state,0);} };
